item.text: {"rule":"The procedure used two stages: after two cats were petted, either that pair stayed or left; then, among the remaining pair, either the petted cat or the other cat stayed. Because these stay/leave choices varied across rounds without an observable pattern, the overarching rule is insufficiently determined."}
